reason: I'd order one to see it in my hands, since the UL number, real customer photos and free 30-day returns take most of the risk out, and 3 to 5 days fits my timeline. I would not order a whole room's worth from a store I've never heard of until the first one arrives and looks right.
objection: I can't judge the quality from photos, and paper and LED fixtures can look cheap in person. I don't know this store, and 60 reviews is not many.
